newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile March supermarket sales rise 5.9 pct vs 96.
newsitem.headline: Chile March supermarket sales rise 5.9 pct vs 96.

text.p: Chilean supermarket sales climbed 5.9 percent in March against the same month last year, said the Chilean Supermarket Association.
The March figure brings the rise in the first quarter to 3.6 percent compared with the first three months of 1996.
"This result breaks the negative trend in sales which grew hardly two percent in February," said the association.
Chileans are Latin America's most frequent supermarket shoppers and the figures are widely regarded as a barometer of consumer spending.
